{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
# Status 'completed' is the only one we want
completed_mask = data['status'] == 'completed'

# Filter data: only completed orders and exclude QA orders
filtered_data = data[completed_mask & ~qa_mask]

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = filtered_data.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

conversion_rates, best_segment, best_rate"}
